name: braid
description: Simple tool to help track vendor branches in a Git repository

repo.name: braid
repo.description: Simple tool to help track vendor branches in a Git repository.

readme.summary: Well-structured README with strong examples and a clear quick-start workflow, but configuration options and environment-specific setup details are underdeveloped.
readme.top_issue: Configuration of .braids.json is only briefly mentioned without documenting the full schema or available options beyond a high-level list.

injection_risks.description: The use of `T.unsafe(Main).run` could potentially lead to injection risks if the input is not properly sanitized.
The `@argv` variable is used directly in the `Commands::Diff.new(local_path, options).run` call without proper sanitization, potentially leading to injection risks.

critical_findings: Potential injection risks due to unsanitized input
security.summary: The code has some security concerns related to potential injection risks, insufficient input validation, and error exposure, but overall it appears to be well-structured and follows good practices.
